officialForms.officialFormId: PRB Certificate of Sealing Eligibility Acknowledgement
officialForms.revisionNote: Published undated alongside dated 09/18/2024 application and guideline files. Whether it carries its own revision date is an open research note — counsel flag cf-04.
officialForms.sha256Note: No hash is recorded for this form anywhere in the pinned registry entry. See counsel flag cf-15.

owningLane.scope: Official PDF acquisition, field mapping and overlay for the Board's Certificate of Sealing Acknowledgement. Lane D also owns resolving the undated-revision question (cf-04) as part of source capture.

orderingRule: Completed BEFORE the Certificate of Sealing Application (component il-prb-cert-primary-filing-1) and included with the petition, or the petition is rejected and returned. This is the single highest-consequence ordering rule on the route: getting it wrong voids the whole stage-1 filing.

manualCompletion: Witness or attorney signature on the acknowledgement — Acknowledgement, Signature of Witness/Attorney. Third-party completed. LegalEase leaves it blank.
participantTreatment.protectedBlankNote: Board hearing date, Board decision and any prediction of Board discretion are left blank.
participantTreatment.outsidePartyBlankNote: The witness or attorney signature is an act of a third party and is never prefilled, never suggested and never signed on that party's behalf.

unresolvedForThisComponent: The form's own revision date. It is published undated (counsel flag cf-04).
No public URL and no SHA-256 is recorded; staleness cannot be detected (counsel flag cf-15).
